_note: B2C consumer SaaS (Laravel 13 + React 19) for standardised-exam prep. Auth, billing, and exam-lifecycle paths escalate to critical ceremony. App runs inside the mylantite_app container hosted by the DevContainer harness.

G1.name: Code Standards
G1.desc: Formatting, static analysis, lint, TypeScript types, and generated TS enum drift all clean. PASS = zero errors (warnings acceptable, documented).
commands: docker exec mylantite_app composer ts:enums && git diff --exit-code -- resources/js

G2.name: Security
G2.desc: No OWASP Top 10 violations. Per-user isolation: user-owned models carry user_id FK + policy ownership check. user_id/role/is_admin never in $fillable. All endpoints validate via FormRequests. Cross-user access returns 403 (IDOR). No raw SQL without parameter binding. FAIL on any Critical/High finding.

G3.name: Alignment
G3.desc: Implementation matches the original request: all requested functionality present, no scope creep, solves the stated problem, endpoints match the architected design.

G4.name: Test Coverage
G4.desc: >=80% overall, >=90% on lines added, >=95% on critical paths (auth/authz flows, per-user isolation, exam attempt lifecycle, payment processing, RBAC policies). FAIL below 80% overall or 90% critical.
commands: docker exec mylantite_app php artisan test --coverage

G5.name: Domain Correctness
G5.desc: Business rules produce correct results; cross-user data access impossible; each role limited to permitted resources; boundary conditions tested; referential integrity maintained.

G6.name: DevOps Readiness
G6.desc: Migrations reversible (safe down()) and independent of uncommitted migrations; Docker builds healthy; new env vars documented in .env.example; new config keys have sensible defaults.

G7.name: TDD Compliance
G7.desc: Red-Green-Refactor followed: tests written before implementation, minimal code to green, refactor without behavior change. No implementation committed without corresponding tests. Tests assert behavior, not implementation details.

format: docker exec mylantite_app npx prettier --write resources/js
typecheck: docker exec mylantite_app composer ts:enums && git diff --exit-code -- resources/js
test: docker exec mylantite_app php artisan test
